description: A ground-level photograph illustrating an agricultural landscape, likely depicting the land cover category "Lines of trees and scrub" as defined in the document. The foreground and midground are dominated by a vast, vibrant field of bright yellow flowering plants, characteristic of a rapeseed or canola crop. In the background, a continuous, linear strip of tall, green deciduous trees forms a distinct boundary against a clear, light blue sky. This line of trees exemplifies the definition of "Lines of trees and scrub" within a matrix of cultivated land.
